FeatureDocuments: Create and edit documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDF forms right in your browser.
FeatureOrganize: Find anything in seconds with search, filters, favorites, and the list of recent files.
FeatureSecurity: Flexible access rights protect your files, and deleted items can be restored from Trash.
FeatureSharing: Grant access to your files and co-edit documents with others in real time.
TourActions: Create a file right where you are — it opens in the editor immediately, no download needed.
TourActionsDragDrop: To upload, drag files or folders straight onto the list.
TourActionsFormats: Documents, spreadsheets, and presentations are fully compatible with Office formats.
TourActionsPdfForm: Pick PDF to build a fillable form others can complete.
TourAiChat: Ask the AI assistant to summarize a document, find the right file, or draft text for you.
TourColumns: Click the gear to choose which columns to show — author, size, type, or the date of the last change.
TourFilesFilter: Filters narrow the list down when the name alone is not enough.
TourFilesFilterTypes: Filter by file type, author, or search inside subfolders.
TourFileItem: Every row is a file or folder you can act on without opening it.
TourFileItemContextMenu: The three dots open all actions: share, move, copy, rename, download, delete.
TourFileItemOpen: Click the name to open the file in the editor.
TourFileItemSelect: Tick the checkbox to pick several files and act on them at once.
TourInfoPanel: The info panel is where sharing and file history live.
TourInfoPanelHistory: See who changed what, and restore an earlier version.
TourInfoPanelShare: Create a link with the access level you need, or invite people by email.
TourMyDocuments: This is your personal space — the files you own.
TourMyDocumentsPrivate: Nobody else can see them until you share them.
TourMyDocumentsShare: For teamwork, use rooms instead: they have members and roles.
TourRecent: Recent collects everything you opened lately, wherever it is stored.
TourRecentFavorites: Mark a file with a star and it shows up in Favorites.
TourSearch: Search covers the current folder and everything nested inside it.
TourSearchContent: Enable searching inside file content to find a document by a phrase.
TourSearchFilters: Type a name, or part of it — results update as you type.
TourShared: Files and folders other people gave you access to appear here — they don't take up your storage space.
TourSort: Sort the list by name, size, type, or the date of the last change.
TourSortView: The icon next to it switches between the list and tile layouts.
TourTrash: Deleted files land in Trash, so a wrong click is not the end.
TourTrashAutoClean: Restore an item to where it was, or empty Trash to free up space.
